data.one_liner: Provides a widget that highlights its child with a customizable animation.
data.what_it_does: Wrap any widget with SmoothHighlight to animate a background color flash. ValueChangeHighlight adds automatic highlighting when a supplied value changes, with options to exclude specific transitions.
use_when: You need to draw user attention to a widget or changed value
You want a simple, no‑dependency way to add highlight animations
strengths: Very easy to integrate via a single widget
weaknesses: No built‑in support for advanced animation curves

alternatives.name: shimmer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a similar attention‑drawing effect with a moving gradient, useful for loading placeholders
